Parts.Description: A soft green meadow of enchanted grass with a flagstone plaza for the Wizard Shiba.
Parts.Name: Moonlit Meadow

Parts.Description: A great rune circle with six standing stones and crystals. The Wizard Shiba's magic source.
Parts.Name: Arcane Circle

Parts.Description: A tall stone tower with a wobbly top and a pointy purple hat of a roof. Wizards live here.
Parts.Name: Crooked Wizard Tower

Parts.Description: A giant iron cauldron full of green brew, bubbling over a crackling fire.
Parts.Name: Bubbling Cauldron

Parts.Description: A crooked little cottage that sells bottles of every colour, with a barrel at the door.
Parts.Name: Potion Shop

Parts.Description: A mossy stone well with a tiny roof. Throw in a coin and make a wish!
Parts.Name: Wishing Well

Parts.Description: Giant spotted mushrooms in a fairy ring. The biggest one has a little round door.
Parts.Name: Fairy Mushrooms

Parts.Description: A rack of flying brooms and a pointy hat, ready for a quick ride.
Parts.Name: Broom Rack

Parts.Description: Raised beds of magic pumpkins, purple cabbages and star flowers, guarded by a scarecrow wizard.
Parts.Name: Potion Garden

Parts.Description: A rocky heap of sparkling blue, purple and pink crystals that hum when you walk by.
Parts.Name: Crystal Cluster

Parts.Description: A gothic library with a pointy tower, stained glass and a thousand spell books.
Parts.Name: Spell Library

Parts.Description: A tiered stone fountain with a golden star on top and clear blue water.
Parts.Name: Starlight Fountain

Parts.Description: A gnarled old tree with a wise owl that wears its own tiny wizard hat.
Parts.Name: Owl Roost

Parts.Description: A workbench with bubbling flasks, copper pipes and a shelf of strange bottles.
Parts.Name: Alchemy Bench

Parts.Description: Two round targets and a straw dummy in a pointy hat. Practice your zaps here!
Parts.Name: Spell Range

Parts.Description: A twig nest with a giant green egg that wobbles, and a few smaller eggs and gold coins.
Parts.Name: Dragon Egg Nest

Parts.Description: A humped stone bridge over a lily pond, with golden lanterns at both ends.
Parts.Name: Moon Bridge

Parts.Description: A huge open spell book on a stone lectern, with a quill that writes by itself.
Parts.Name: Giant Spellbook

Parts.Description: A round pavilion with a purple roof, where a big crystal ball shows the future.
Parts.Name: Crystal Ball Pavilion

Parts.Description: A tall stone statue of the first great wizard, with a long beard and a glowing staff.
Parts.Name: Founder Statue

Parts.Description: A round tower with a copper dome that opens to the sky and a big brass telescope.
Parts.Name: Star Observatory

Parts.Description: A proud stone griffin with spread wings, guarding the road to the tower.
Parts.Name: Griffin Statue

Parts.Description: A stone archway with a swirling purple gate to somewhere far, far away.
Parts.Name: Magic Portal

Parts.Description: A rock island that floats high above the path with a tiny castle and a tree on top.
Parts.Name: Floating Sky Isle

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a golden sun, spinning planets and brass rings on a stone plinth. Pure wizard power!
Parts.Name: Grand Orrery
